tldr: 黃仁勳 GTC Taipei 主題演講與 RTX Spark PC 晶片發表帶動台股大漲 640 點、收 45,337.91 點，首度站上 45,000 點關卡。
美股三大指數同創收盤新高，輝達切入 PC 晶片市場大漲逾 6%，戴爾、惠普、慧與在 AI 硬體行情中強勢噴出。
油價自 2026 年高點大幅回落，布蘭特原油跌破 100 美元至約 92 美元，市場樂觀看待美伊延長停火 60 天，通膨疑慮略為緩和。
金管會推進高資產家族傳承工具，研擬最長 100 年的「連續受益人信託」，並因應高齡化釋出法規鬆綁與保險定價放寬訊號。
財政部遺贈稅法修正草案擬將「死亡前 2 年贈與配偶」財產改以受贈人按比例為納稅義務人，回應憲判字第 11 號判決意旨。

items.title_zh: 黃仁勳開講助攻 台股飆 640 點收 45,337.91 創新高、首破 45,000
items.title_en: TAIEX rockets 640 points to a record above 45,000 on Huang's keynote
items.summary_zh: 台股週一大漲 640.97 點（約 1.4%），收在歷史新高 45,337.91 點，盤中與收盤雙雙首度站上 45,000 點大關。行情由輝達執行長黃仁勳 GTC Taipei 主題演講及 Computex 2026 開展點火，成交量擴大至 1.96 兆元，電子類指數盤中更首度突破 3,000 點。此波突破延續台股近期極強走勢，反映台灣是全球 AI 資本支出循環的最大受惠者，也凸顯本地市場與輝達產品藍圖、AI 硬體供應鏈的連動程度已達空前緊密，後續須留意創高後的籌碼與獲利了結壓力。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX surged 640.97 points (about 1.4%) on Monday to close at a record 45,337.91, breaking above the 45,000 mark for the first time. The rally was powered by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's GTC Taipei keynote and the opening of Computex 2026, with turnover swelling to NT$1.96 trillion and the electronics sub-index crossing 3,000 points intraday for the first time. The breakout extends an exceptionally strong run for Taiwan equities, which have been the prime beneficiary of the global AI capital-expenditure cycle, and underscores how tightly the local market is now tethered to Nvidia's product roadmap and the broader AI hardware supply chain.

items.title_zh: 台積電盤中創高 2,415 元 尾盤翻黑收 2,355 元 市值一度逾 62 兆
items.title_en: TSMC hits intraday record NT$2,415 before paring gains to close at NT$2,355
items.summary_zh: 台積電盤中最高上漲 60 元至歷史新天價 2,415 元，市值一度攀至約 62.62 兆元，惟尾盤遭調節壓回，終場收 2,355 元。此一回吐顯示即便是權值王，在連續急漲後仍面臨獲利了結賣壓；不過受惠伺服器、機器人與被動元件等族群全面開花，大盤仍以大漲作收。台積電為加權指數第一大權值股，也是輝達新款 RTX Spark 晶片（採台積電 3 奈米製程代工）的製造核心，其走勢仍是左右指數方向的關鍵，投資人須觀察高檔震盪是否轉為類股輪動。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing climbed as much as NT$60 to an intraday all-time high of NT$2,415, briefly lifting its market capitalisation to around NT$62.62 trillion, before late-session selling dragged the stock back to close at NT$2,355. The reversal showed that even the market's anchor stock faced profit-taking after a vertical run, yet the broader index still finished sharply higher thanks to breadth across server, robotics and component names. As the single largest weighting in the TAIEX and the manufacturing backbone of Nvidia's new RTX Spark chip — built on TSMC's 3-nanometre process — the foundry remains the pivotal driver of index direction.

items.title_zh: 外資單日買超 368 億 三大法人同步加碼 期指淨空單創新高
items.title_en: Foreign investors pour in NT$36.8 billion as index futures short positions hit record
items.summary_zh: 外資週一買超台股 368.17 億元，帶動三大法人合計買超 380.67 億元。同時，外資將台指期淨空單同步增加至 64,673 口，創歷史最高，明顯對其龐大現貨多單進行避險。這種「現貨作多、期貨布空」的分歧布局，顯示法人一面追逐 AI 行情動能，一面在創高估值下防範急跌風險。在指數挺進 45,000 點之上的未知區間之際，此一籌碼結構值得持續追蹤，後市若出現獲利了結，期現貨的對沖部位將是觀察波動的重要指標。
items.summary_en: Overseas institutions bought a net NT$36.817 billion of Taiwan shares on Monday, helping the three major institutional investors register combined net buying of NT$38.067 billion. At the same time, foreign investors lifted their net short position in TAIEX futures to a record 64,673 contracts, a notable hedge against their large cash-market longs. The split positioning suggests institutions are riding the AI-fuelled momentum in equities while simultaneously protecting against a sharp pullback at record valuations — a stance worth monitoring as the index pushes into uncharted territory above 45,000.

items.title_zh: 伺服器族群大噴發 緯創、宏碁、華碩跳空漲停
items.title_en: Server makers explode higher — Wistron, Acer, Asustek gap up to limit
items.summary_zh: 在輝達與戴爾為新一代 AI PC 與伺服器背書後，伺服器與 AI 硬體供應鏈領漲，緯創、宏碁、華碩同步跳空漲停。此波急漲反映投資人深信，隨著輝達將版圖由資料中心 GPU 延伸至終端 AI 處理器，台灣代工廠與品牌廠可望接獲超額訂單。AI 伺服器的需求能見度仍是市場核心題材，多檔個股攻上漲停，顯示行情已從台積電一檔擴散至組裝、散熱與零組件等生態系各環節，惟漲停股若量價背離仍須留意短線過熱回檔風險。
items.summary_en: The server and AI-hardware supply chain led the charge, with Wistron, Acer and Asustek all gapping up to their daily limits after Nvidia and Dell endorsed the next wave of AI PCs and servers. The surge reflected investor conviction that Taiwan's contract manufacturers and brand vendors stand to capture outsized orders as Nvidia extends its reach from data-centre GPUs into client-side AI processors. Demand visibility for AI servers remains a central theme, and the limit-up moves signalled that the rally is broadening well beyond TSMC into the assembly, cooling and component layers of the ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 實體 AI 平台點火 機器人概念股漲停齊飛
items.title_en: Robotics concept stocks limit up on Nvidia's physical-AI platform
items.summary_zh: 輝達在 GTC Taipei 發表新的實體 AI 與機器人開發工具後，一籃子台灣機器人概念股大漲，廣宇、聰泰、全球傳動、穎漢、東台等多檔攻上漲停。此波行情將 AI 投資題材由晶片、伺服器延伸至新興的機器人與自動化供應鏈，台灣的傳動元件、運動控制與工具機廠商，有望成為「實體 AI（embodied AI）」建置潮的關鍵受惠者。市場正逐步反映由輝達軟體與參考平台支撐的人形與工業機器人多年資本循環，但概念股輪動快速，追高仍須評估基本面與接單實質落地程度。
items.summary_en: Following Nvidia's unveiling of new physical-AI and robotics development tools at GTC Taipei, a basket of Taiwanese robotics concept stocks — including Kuang Yu, Soft-Tek, Hiwin (全球傳動), Ying Han and Tongtai — surged to their daily limits. The move extends the AI investment narrative beyond chips and servers into the emerging robotics and automation supply chain, where Taiwanese makers of motion components, transmission systems and machine tools could become key beneficiaries of an "embodied AI" build-out. Investors are increasingly pricing in a multi-year capital cycle for humanoid and industrial robots underpinned by Nvidia's software and reference platforms.

items.title_zh: 黃仁勳 GTC Taipei 宣告代理式與實體 AI 時代來臨
items.title_en: Huang declares the era of agentic and physical AI at GTC Taipei
items.summary_zh: 輝達執行長黃仁勳於 GTC Taipei 主題演講中宣告「有用的」代理式 AI 已經到來，並一口氣發表多項新品，包括 RTX Spark（N1X）PC 超級晶片、面向實體 AI 的 Cosmos 3 基礎模型，以及 Isaac Groot 機器人開發平台。演講將台灣定位為下一波 AI 建置的製造核心，並點名數百家本地供應鏈夥伴。隨著輝達平台由資料中心訓練延伸至終端裝置與機器人，黃仁勳描繪的藍圖未來數年將直接牽動台灣晶片廠、ODM、零組件業者與新興機器人廠商，產業鏈受惠面顯著擴大，惟實際營收貢獻節奏仍待觀察。
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang used his GTC Taipei keynote to proclaim the arrival of "useful" agentic AI and to unveil a sweep of new products, including the RTX Spark (N1X) PC superchip, the Cosmos 3 foundation model for physical AI, and the Isaac Groot robotics development platform. The address positioned Taiwan as the manufacturing heart of the next AI build-out and named hundreds of local partners across the supply chain. By extending Nvidia's platform from data-centre training into client devices and robotics, Huang laid out a roadmap that directly implicates Taiwan's chipmakers, ODMs, component vendors and emerging robotics players for years to come.

items.title_zh: 台積電全面導入輝達加速運算於晶圓製造
items.title_en: TSMC deploys Nvidia accelerated computing across chip manufacturing
items.summary_zh: 輝達揭露，台積電正運用其加速運算與 AI 技術推進半導體設計與製造，涵蓋微影、製程模擬、先進製程控制、晶圓廠營運最佳化與缺陷檢測等環節。此合作深化了全球龍頭晶圓代工廠與主導 AI 晶片設計商之間的共生關係：輝達的 GPU 與軟體正愈來愈深地嵌入製造輝達自家晶片的生產線中。對台積電而言，AI 驅動的製造可望帶來更高良率、先進製程更快放量與更嚴格的缺陷管控，形成英特爾、三星等對手難以大規模複製的競爭優勢，進一步鞏固其先進製程護城河。
items.summary_en: Nvidia disclosed that TSMC is using its accelerated-computing and AI technologies to advance semiconductor design and manufacturing, spanning lithography, process simulation, advanced process control, fab-operations optimisation and defect inspection. The collaboration deepens the symbiosis between the world's leading foundry and the dominant AI-chip designer: Nvidia's GPUs and software are increasingly embedded in the very production lines that build Nvidia's own chips. For TSMC, AI-driven manufacturing promises higher yields, faster ramp of leading-edge nodes and tighter defect control — competitive advantages that are difficult for rivals such as Intel and Samsung to replicate at scale.

items.title_zh: 大摩：2026 AI 半導體需求估增約 70% 瓶頸轉向記憶體與機櫃
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley: 2026 AI semiconductor demand to grow ~70%, bottlenecks shift away from TSMC
items.summary_zh: 摩根士丹利重申看好 2026 年 AI 半導體，預估需求年增約 70%，並認為主要供給瓶頸將來自特殊記憶體（如高頻寬記憶體 HBM）與伺服器機櫃，而非台積電的晶圓產能。此一論點意味著台積電代工產出已非 AI 算力的限制因素，市場焦點將轉向 HBM 供應商、先進封裝與機櫃級系統整合商。對台灣整體科技產業而言，在雲端巨擘資本支出維持高檔下，此論述支撐記憶體、散熱與伺服器組裝族群續有上行空間，惟須留意供需若反轉時的庫存與報價風險。
items.summary_en: Morgan Stanley reiterated a bullish view on AI semiconductors for 2026, forecasting demand growth of roughly 70% and arguing that the key supply constraints will come from specialty memory (such as high-bandwidth memory) and server racks rather than TSMC's wafer capacity. The call implies that TSMC's foundry output is no longer the gating factor for AI compute, redirecting investor attention to HBM suppliers, advanced packaging and rack-level system integrators. For Taiwan's broader tech complex, the thesis supports continued upside across memory, cooling and server-assembly names as hyperscaler capex stays elevated.

items.title_zh: 金管會修正保險業內控及稽核辦法 強化資安防護
items.title_en: FSC tightens insurers' internal controls and audit rules to bolster cybersecurity
items.summary_zh: 金管會於 5 月 26 日修正發布「保險業內部控制及稽核制度實施辦法」，全面增強保險業資訊安全防護力。在金融機構面臨日益升高的網路威脅、且保險業掌握大量敏感保戶資料之際，此次修正強化了保險業對 IT 控管與稽核功能的治理要求。此舉為金管會強化台灣金融體系營運與資安韌性的整體政策之一環，保險業者後續須升級內部控制架構與稽核覆蓋範圍以符合新規，預期將推升資安與內控相關投資，並提高業者對委外與第三方風險的管理標準。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission promulgated amendments to the Regulations Governing the Implementation of Internal Control and Audit Systems for insurance enterprises on 26 May, strengthening information-security defences across the sector. The revisions tighten governance over insurers' IT controls and audit functions amid rising cyber-threats to financial institutions handling sensitive policyholder data. The move is part of a broader regulatory push to harden the resilience of Taiwan's financial system against operational and cyber risks, and insurers will need to upgrade internal control frameworks and audit coverage to comply.

items.title_zh: 銀行局預告修正金控合併資本適足性管理辦法
items.title_en: Banking Bureau pre-announces revisions to financial-holding capital adequacy rules
items.summary_zh: 銀行局於 5 月 28 日預告修正「金融控股公司合併資本適足性管理辦法」，以配合保險業新清償能力制度之調整。此次修正旨在確保集團層級的資本適足率能適當反映保險子公司的風險樣態與資本需求，呼應台灣保險業朝新清償能力標準（如接軌 ICS）過渡的政策方向。旗下擁有保險子公司的金控公司，後續須重新校準集團資本規劃，對於主導台灣金融版圖的大型銀保型金控而言，影響尤為重大，須提前評估資本配置與股利政策，以維持集團資本適足與監理合規。
items.summary_en: The Banking Bureau on 28 May pre-announced amendments to the Regulations Governing the Consolidated Capital Adequacy of Financial Holding Companies, aligning the framework with adjustments to the insurance sector's new solvency regime. The changes aim to ensure that capital adequacy at the group level appropriately reflects the risk profiles and capital requirements of insurance subsidiaries as Taiwan transitions toward a new solvency standard. Financial holding companies with insurance arms will need to recalibrate group capital planning, a meaningful consideration for the large bank-insurance conglomerates that dominate Taiwan's financial landscape.

items.title_zh: 金管會預告防詐辦法 納入虛擬資產服務業者
items.title_en: Regulators pre-announce anti-fraud compliance rules covering virtual-asset service providers
items.summary_zh: 主管機關於 5 月 28 日預告修正「金融機構及提供虛擬資產服務之事業或人員防制詐欺犯罪危害應遵循事項辦法」。此次草案將防詐合規義務由傳統金融機構延伸至虛擬資產（加密貨幣）平台，反映監理機關日益重視虛擬資產通路在詐騙不法所得洗錢過程中所扮演的角色。在台營運的虛擬資產服務業者（VASP）將面臨更高的盡職調查、交易監控與通報要求，此舉為全國打詐整體政策的一環，預期將提高業者的法遵成本，並推動產業朝合規化與機構化方向發展。
items.summary_en: The authorities on 28 May pre-announced amendments to the regulations on matters that financial institutions and virtual-asset service providers (VASPs) must observe to prevent and mitigate fraud-related crime. The proposed rules extend anti-fraud compliance obligations to crypto-asset platforms alongside traditional financial institutions, reflecting regulators' intensifying focus on the role of virtual-asset channels in laundering proceeds from scams. VASPs operating in Taiwan will face heightened due-diligence, monitoring and reporting requirements, part of a coordinated national effort to curb the surge in financial fraud.

items.title_zh: 金管會釋訊號：因應高齡化 將推法規鬆綁、保險定價放寬
items.title_en: FSC signals deregulation and looser insurance pricing for an ageing society
items.summary_zh: 金管會保險局副局長蔡火炎於 6 月 1 日表示，將因應台灣快速高齡化推動法規鬆綁與保險定價放寬。此方向意味保險業者在設計與定價長壽、長照及退休所得等商品時，可望取得更大彈性，有助滿足高齡家庭需求並帶動商品創新。監理立場轉趨寬鬆，可能為壽險業開啟新的成長動能；惟在放寬定價與商品設計的同時，仍須審慎兼顧消費者保護與清償能力，避免費率惡性競爭。後續具體子法與商品審查標準的鬆綁幅度，將是業者布局高齡商機的關鍵觀察點。
items.summary_en: Speaking on 1 June, Insurance Bureau Deputy Director-General Tsai Huo-yen indicated that the FSC will push regulatory relaxation and looser insurance-pricing rules to respond to Taiwan's rapidly ageing population. The direction suggests insurers may gain more flexibility in designing and pricing products such as longevity, long-term-care and retirement-income coverage, helping the industry meet demand from older households while supporting product innovation. The shift toward a more accommodative regulatory stance could open new growth avenues for life insurers, though it will require careful balancing against consumer-protection and solvency considerations.

items.title_zh: 金管會擬開放「連續受益人信託」助高資產家族留財台灣
items.title_en: FSC plans 100-year "successive-beneficiary trust" to keep family wealth in Taiwan
items.summary_zh: 金管會於 5 月 5 日偕同財政部、法務部完成跨部會研商，擬開放「連續受益人信託」，並訂定最長存續期間 100 年及相關課稅原則。此種在歐美家族辦公室中常見的機制，可讓家族在信託契約中預先安排多順位受益人，使家族資產隨世代更迭持續運作。該政策明確以協助高資產家族達成長期、跨世代傳承為目標，同時將財富留在台灣境內，為國內私人銀行與家族辦公室業務增添重要工具。對財管業者而言，百年信託若上路，可望成為爭取超高資產客群、深化傳承規劃服務的關鍵切入點，惟課稅原則與存續期間設計仍待最終定案。
items.summary_en: The FSC, together with the Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Justice, completed cross-ministerial deliberations on 5 May on opening a "successive-beneficiary trust" framework, setting a maximum duration of up to 100 years and defining the associated taxation principles. The structure — common among Western family offices — lets families pre-arrange multiple tiers of beneficiaries so that assets can continue operating across generations. The initiative is explicitly aimed at helping high-net-worth families achieve long-term, multi-generational succession while keeping wealth onshore in Taiwan, a significant addition to the domestic private-banking and family-office toolkit.

items.title_zh: 金管會鬆綁全委代操限制 79 家業者受惠
items.title_en: FSC relaxes discretionary-mandate limits, benefiting 79 operators
items.summary_zh: 金管會於 5 月 17 日鬆綁全權委託投資（全委代操）相關限制，預估將有 79 家金控、投信投顧與壽險業者受惠。此次鬆綁給予資產管理業者在執行全委代操時更大彈性，有助發展更高附加價值的財富管理與資產管理服務。此舉呼應台灣打造亞洲資產管理中心的整體政策，擴大金融機構可提供予富裕客群與法人客戶的客製化、專業代操方案範圍。對財管與投信業者而言，代操彈性提升有望帶動 AUM 與管理費收入成長，並推升專業資產管理在台灣財管版圖中的占比，惟仍須強化風險控管與利益衝突防範。
items.summary_en: On 17 May the FSC eased restrictions on discretionary investment management (全委代操), a change expected to benefit 79 financial-holding, securities-investment-trust and life-insurance operators. The relaxation gives asset managers greater latitude in running discretionary mandates, supporting the development of higher-value wealth-management and asset-management services. The move dovetails with Taiwan's broader push to build an asset-management hub, expanding the range of customised, professionally managed solutions that institutions can offer affluent and institutional clients.

items.title_zh: 亞洲資產管理中心高雄專區見成效 資產管理專法 7 月底公布草案
items.title_en: Kaohsiung asset-management zone gains traction; asset-management act draft due end-July
items.summary_zh: 金管會打造亞洲資產管理中心的政策已現初步成果：高雄專區中，與投信投顧合作銷售其引進之非投信基金性質境外基金的財管業務，累計承作金額已達 22 億元。監理機關並透露，「資產管理專法」草案預計於 7 月底公布。上述進展顯示，台灣境內跨境商品銷售與資產匯集平台正逐步成熟，將擴大高資產與法人客戶在台可投資的商品選擇。對財管與資產管理業者而言，專法若提供租稅與監理誘因，可望吸引資金回流並深化在地資產管理生態，惟成效仍取決於專法最終的開放幅度與配套措施。
items.summary_en: The FSC's Asian asset-management hub initiative is showing early results: under the Kaohsiung dedicated zone, wealth-management business focused on distributing offshore funds (non-SITC-type) introduced via cooperation with securities-investment-trust and consulting firms has reached cumulative sales of NT$2.2 billion. Regulators have also signalled that a draft "asset-management act" will be unveiled by the end of July. Together these developments point to a maturing onshore platform for cross-border product distribution and asset gathering, expanding the menu of investment vehicles available to high-net-worth and institutional clients in Taiwan.

items.title_zh: 金管會放寬主動式 ETF 單一公司投資上限 台積電迎活水
items.title_en: FSC raises active-ETF single-company holding cap, channelling flows toward TSMC
items.summary_zh: 金管會放寬主動式 ETF 投資單一公司的比例上限，使相關產品可對台積電等權值龍頭配置更高比重。此調整回應了主動式 ETF 在追蹤少數超大型權值股占比過高市場時所面臨的實務困難，給予基金經理人更大彈性以反映其對龍頭股的看法。對投資人而言，此舉可望使國內掛牌的主動式 ETF 更貼近 AI 主導的多頭行情，並將新增資金導向市場權值龍頭。不過，放寬單一個股上限也意味產品集中度提高、與大盤連動更深，投資人須留意龍頭股回檔時的波動放大效應。
items.summary_en: The FSC relaxed the cap on the proportion of an active ETF that may be invested in a single company, a change that effectively allows products to allocate more heavily to dominant index constituents such as TSMC. The adjustment responds to the practical difficulty active ETFs faced in tracking a market where a handful of mega-cap names carry outsized weights, and it gives fund managers more flexibility to reflect their conviction in leading stocks. For investors, the move could make domestically listed active ETFs more representative of the AI-led rally, channelling fresh flows toward the market's heavyweight names.

items.title_zh: 財政部預告遺贈稅法修正 改以受贈人為納稅義務人
items.title_en: MOF drafts Estate and Gift Tax Act amendment shifting liability to gift recipients
items.summary_zh: 財政部預告修正「遺產及贈與稅法」部分條文草案，以回應憲法法庭憲判字第 11 號判決意旨。現行法將所有遺產合併計稅、由全體繼承人共同負擔；草案則明定，針對死亡前 2 年內贈與配偶及各順序繼承人的財產，稽徵機關須按該財產占遺產總額的比率，直接以「受贈人」為納稅義務人發單課徵，並以受贈財產為限負繳納義務。此修法針對過去實務上「臨終前將高額資產贈與配偶、繼承人再集體拋棄繼承」，導致未獲贈財產者承擔巨額遺產稅的不公情形。草案並調整「配偶剩餘財產差額分配請求權」的計算方式，對高資產家族的傳承與贈與規劃影響重大，應重新檢視既有架構。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance has pre-announced a draft amendment to the Estate and Gift Tax Act in response to Constitutional Court Judgment 113-Hsien-Pan-11. Under current law, all estate assets are taxed in aggregate and the burden falls jointly on all heirs; the draft would, for property gifted to a spouse and statutory heirs within two years before death, levy estate tax directly on each recipient on a pro-rata basis, capped at the value of the gifted property. The change addresses past abuses in which a decedent transferred large assets to a spouse before death and heirs then collectively disclaimed inheritance, leaving non-recipient heirs liable for outsized estate tax. The draft also revises the spousal remaining-property difference claim calculation.

items.title_zh: 財政部發布死亡前 2 年贈與配偶財產併計遺產課稅作業原則
items.title_en: MOF issues administrative principles on two-year pre-death spousal gifts
items.summary_zh: 財政部賦稅署發布「被繼承人死亡前 2 年內贈與配偶之財產併計遺產總額課稅稽徵作業處理原則」。該原則具體規範此類「擬制遺產」財產如何計算，以及由此產生的遺產稅應如何在各受贈人間分攤，在母法全面修正前，先為稅捐機關與納稅人提供更明確的操作指引。對傳承規劃者而言，此作業原則揭示了稽徵方向：死亡前的配偶間贈與將受到嚴格檢視，且受贈人須按比例負擔稅負，更凸顯重新檢討贈與策略與時點安排的必要性，高資產客戶宜及早與會計師、律師重新盤點傳承藍圖。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance's Taxation Administration has issued processing principles for aggregating into the gross estate property gifted to a spouse within two years before death. The principles operationalise how such constructive-estate property is computed and how the resulting estate-tax liability is apportioned among recipients, providing tax authorities and taxpayers with clearer guidance ahead of the broader statutory amendment. For estate planners, the principles signal the direction of enforcement: pre-death spousal transfers will be scrutinised and recipients held proportionately liable, reinforcing the need to revisit gifting strategies and timing.

items.title_zh: 2026 通膨連動減稅多項門檻同步調升上路
items.title_en: 2026 inflation-linked tax relief takes effect across multiple thresholds
items.summary_zh: 隨通膨延續至 2026 年，多項依消費者物價指數（CPI）連動的稅制調整正式上路，包括綜合所得稅免稅額、基本生活費、各項扣除額、課稅級距，以及退職所得免稅額度等皆依物價指數調高。依規定，當累計物價漲幅達法定門檻即須調整，這些調升可降低個人與家庭的實質稅負，部分抵銷物價上漲對實質所得的侵蝕。申報相關年度的納稅人應確認採用最新數據，以充分運用所得稅、贈與稅與遺產稅的合法節稅空間。對高資產族群而言，免稅額與級距調整雖幅度有限，仍應納入年度稅務與傳承規劃一併檢視。
items.summary_en: With inflation persisting into 2026, a series of CPI-indexed tax adjustments have taken effect, raising the personal income-tax exemption, the basic living-expense allowance, various deductions, the tax-bracket thresholds and severance/retirement-income limits. The adjustments, mandated when cumulative price increases cross a statutory trigger, lower the effective tax burden for individuals and households and offset some of the erosion of real incomes from higher prices. Taxpayers filing for the relevant year should ensure they apply the updated figures to maximise legitimate savings on income, gift and estate taxes.

items.title_zh: 2026 房屋稅 6 月 1 日截止 逾期滯納金最高 10%
items.title_en: 2026 house-tax payment deadline 1 June; late penalty up to 10%
items.summary_zh: 2026 年房屋稅繳納期限為 6 月 1 日，逾期繳納將加徵最高 10% 的滯納金。納稅人可透過多種管道繳費，遺失或未收到稅單者亦可申請補單。此一提醒雖屬例行，對房產持有人卻具實質意義——錯過期限將觸發逐步加重的滯納金。隨著房產相關稅負（包括房屋稅、地價稅與房地合一稅）在家庭稅務規劃中的比重日益提高，持有人宜留意各項稅目的繳納期限並仔細核對評定現值與稅基，避免因疏漏而額外負擔滯納金，並可一併檢視持有架構是否符合節稅與傳承目標。
items.summary_en: The deadline for paying the 2026 house tax fell on 1 June, with late payment subject to a surcharge of up to 10%. Taxpayers had multiple payment channels available, and those who lost or did not receive their tax bills could obtain replacements. The reminder is a routine but consequential compliance point for property owners, since missing the deadline triggers escalating surcharges. With property-related taxes — including house tax, land value tax and the consolidated housing-and-land income tax — forming an increasingly important part of household tax planning, owners are advised to track deadlines and reconcile assessed values carefully.

items.title_zh: Fed 連 3 度會議維持利率 3.50%–3.75% 能源推升通膨壓力
items.title_en: Fed holds rates at 3.50%–3.75% for a third straight meeting as energy-driven inflation builds
items.summary_zh: 美國聯準會將基準利率目標區間維持在 3.50%–3.75%，為連續第三次會議按兵不動。中東戰事推升國際能源價格，使通膨壓力擴大。在原油價格遠高於年初水準、物價壓力具僵固性之際，市場對政策路徑大幅重新定價：投資人目前認為今年 12 月前升息的機率達顯著水準（部分指標約 46%），與先前預期降息形成戲劇性反轉。升息機率的轉變正重塑全球資產配置，推升殖利率與美元，同時令利率敏感族群的前景更趨複雜。台灣出口與資金面亦將受美元與美債走勢牽動，須密切追蹤後續通膨與 Fed 官員談話。
items.summary_en: The US Federal Reserve has kept its benchmark federal funds rate target range at 3.50%–3.75%, unchanged for a third consecutive meeting, as Middle East conflict pushes up international energy prices and broadens inflationary pressure. With crude trading well above early-year levels and price pressures sticky, markets have sharply re-rated the policy path: investors now assign a meaningful probability — around 46% by some measures — to a rate hike by December, a dramatic reversal from earlier expectations of cuts. The shift in rate-hike odds is reshaping global asset allocation, lifting yields and the dollar while complicating the outlook for rate-sensitive sectors.

items.title_zh: 台灣 4 月 CPI 升至 1.74% 央行料維持審慎觀望
items.title_en: Taiwan's April CPI rises to 1.74%; central bank seen staying cautious
items.summary_zh: 台灣 4 月消費者物價指數（CPI）上升至 1.74%，1 至 4 月平均為 1.35%；短率同步攀升，5 月 18 日兩年期 NCD 利率達 1.442%，較一個月前上升 0.12 個百分點。數據顯示，進口能源價格壓力正逐步傳導至國內通膨，惟整體通膨率以全球標準而言仍屬溫和。市場預期中央銀行將維持審慎觀望立場，在進口通膨、強勢匯率與支持經濟成長之間取得平衡，政策利率料按兵不動，靜待 Fed 與能源市場釋出更明確訊號。對房貸與企業資金成本而言，央行短率走升的方向值得持續關注。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's consumer price index rose to 1.74% in April, lifting the January–April average to 1.35%, while short-term rates climbed — the two-year NCD rate reached 1.442% on 18 May, up 0.12 percentage point from a month earlier. The data suggest imported energy-price pressure is feeding into domestic inflation even as the headline rate stays moderate by global standards. Markets expect Taiwan's central bank (CBC) to maintain a cautious, wait-and-see stance, balancing imported inflation and a firm currency against the need to support growth, with policy likely on hold pending clearer signals from the Fed and energy markets.

items.title_zh: 美 10 年期公債殖利率近 4.45% 油價回落緩和通膨疑慮 金價守 4,500 美元
items.title_en: US 10-year Treasury yield near 4.45% as oil retreat eases inflation angst; gold holds above US$4,500
items.summary_zh: 美國 10 年期公債殖利率於 6 月初徘徊在約 4.45%，接近三週低點，但本月仍上升約 7 個基點；油價大幅回落緩和了近期由通膨主導的債市賣壓。就殖利率曲線而言，2 年期殖利率略高於 4.00%，長天期公債則逼近 4.97%。金價在一段震盪後守住每盎司 4,500 美元之上，夾在較強的美元與較高實質殖利率，以及揮之不去的地緣風險之間。能源價格、通膨預期與 Fed 政策三者的交互作用，仍是左右全球利率與避險資產的主導因素，後續須留意油價與美債的連動。
items.summary_en: The US 10-year Treasury yield hovered around 4.45% into early June, near a three-week low but still up roughly 7 basis points on the month, as a sharp pullback in oil prices tempered the recent inflation-driven sell-off in bonds. Across the curve, two-year yields sat just above 4.00% and the long bond approached 4.97%. Gold steadied above US$4,500 an ounce after a volatile stretch, caught between a firmer dollar and higher real yields on one side and lingering geopolitical risk on the other. The interplay of energy prices, inflation expectations and Fed policy remains the dominant driver of global rates and havens.

items.title_zh: 美伊傳延長停火 60 天 市場避險情緒降溫轉趨偏多
items.title_en: Risk-on tone returns on reported US–Iran 60-day ceasefire extension
items.summary_zh: 隨著報導指出美國與伊朗已達成延長停火 60 天並就德黑蘭核計畫前景展開協商的初步共識，市場情緒明顯改善。此一緩和帶動廣泛的偏多（risk-on）走勢：股市延續漲勢、油價顯著下跌，債券殖利率亦自通膨驅動的高點回落。不過情勢仍屬脆弱——6 月 1 日盤中，原油一度因德黑蘭傳出暫停與華府溝通、並準備封鎖荷莫茲海峽的消息急漲逾 8%，凸顯在荷莫茲海峽攸關全球約 20% 石油運輸之下，地緣政治消息能多快地使全球市場劇烈震盪。投資人對中東情勢與油價的後續發展仍須保持高度警覺。
items.summary_en: Sentiment improved as reports indicated the US and Iran had reached a preliminary understanding to extend a ceasefire by 60 days and begin discussions over the future of Tehran's nuclear programme. The detente catalysed a broad risk-on move: equities extended their rally, oil prices fell meaningfully and bond yields retraced some of their inflation-driven highs. Still, the situation remains fragile — intraday on 1 June, crude briefly spiked over 8% on reports that Tehran had suspended communications and was preparing to close the Strait of Hormuz, underscoring how quickly geopolitical headlines can whipsaw global markets given the strait's role in roughly 20% of world oil trade.

items.title_zh: 美股三大指數同創收盤新高 輝達領軍科技股大漲（2026-06-01）
items.title_en: All three major US indexes close at records as Nvidia powers tech rally (2026-06-01)
items.summary_zh: 標普 500、那斯達克綜合指數與道瓊工業指數週一同創盤中新高與收盤新高，標普漲 0.26%、那斯達克漲 0.42%、道瓊漲 0.09%。輝達在發表新款 PC 處理器後大漲逾 6%，戴爾、惠普分別上漲逾 10%、8%。慧與科技（HPE）因財測強勁、繳出 2018 年來最大獲利驚奇而暴漲 26%，微芯科技（Microchip）亦勁揚 12%。收盤後美股期貨小幅走低。
items.summary_en: The S&P 500, Nasdaq Composite and Dow Jones Industrial Average all notched new intraday highs and record closes on Monday, with the S&P 500 up 0.26%, the Nasdaq up 0.42% and the Dow up 0.09%. Nvidia rose more than 6% after unveiling a new PC processor, while Dell and HP gained more than 10% and 8%. Hewlett Packard Enterprise surged 26% on a strong outlook and its biggest earnings beat since 2018, and Microchip Technology jumped 12%. Futures ticked lower afterward.

items.title_zh: 輝達推 Arm 架構 RTX Spark 晶片切入 PC 市場 英特爾、超微下挫（2026-05-31）
items.title_en: Nvidia jumps into PCs with new Arm-based RTX Spark chip; Intel and AMD slide (2026-05-31)
items.summary_zh: 輝達發表 RTX Spark（又稱 N1X）Arm 架構 PC 超級晶片，與微軟、聯發科共同開發、採台積電 3 奈米製程，今秋將首見於微軟、戴爾、惠普、華碩、聯想與微星的 Windows 筆電。該晶片結合最高 20 核心的 CPU 與 Blackwell 世代 GPU、共享內建記憶體。消息激勵輝達上漲約 4%，而英特爾、超微則因此舉直接挑戰其 PC 處理器霸主地位，分別下跌約 6%、5%。
items.summary_en: Nvidia unveiled the RTX Spark (also called N1X), an Arm-based PC superchip developed with Microsoft and MediaTek and built on TSMC's 3-nanometre process, debuting this fall in Windows laptops from Microsoft, Dell, HP, Asus, Lenovo and MSI. The chip pairs a CPU of up to 20 cores with a Blackwell-generation GPU sharing built-in memory. Nvidia rose ~4% on the news while Intel and AMD fell about 6% and 5% as the move directly challenges their dominance in PC processors.

items.title_zh: 油價自 2026 年高點回落約兩成 受美伊停火樂觀帶動（2026-05-29）
items.title_en: Oil drops 20% from its 2026 peak on US–Iran ceasefire optimism (2026-05-29)
items.summary_zh: 國際原油價格自 2026 年高點下跌約 20%，市場樂觀預期美國與伊朗可能達成停火，紓解對荷莫茲海峽供應中斷的疑慮。布蘭特原油明顯跌破每桶 100 美元、朝約 92 美元靠攏。能源價格回落成為通膨預期的重要紓壓閥，但市場仍戒慎於談判一旦破局或海峽周邊再度升溫，油價可能迅速反彈。
items.summary_en: Crude prices tumbled about 20% from their 2026 high amid growing optimism that the US and Iran could reach a ceasefire, easing fears over supply through the Strait of Hormuz. Brent fell decisively below the US$100 threshold toward roughly US$92 a barrel. The retreat in energy prices has been a key relief valve for inflation expectations, though markets remain wary that any breakdown in talks or fresh escalation near the strait could quickly reverse the move.

items.title_zh: 亞洲科技股飆漲：軟銀漲 14% 超車豐田 南韓 Kospi 漲 3.7%（2026-06-01）
items.title_en: Asia tech surges: SoftBank jumps 14% to top Toyota, Korea's Kospi up 3.7% (2026-06-01)
items.summary_zh: 亞股週一同搭 AI 熱潮：東京方面，OpenAI 投資方軟銀集團股價大漲 14%，市值超越豐田汽車，登上日本市值龍頭。南韓 Kospi 指數上漲 3.7%，由三星、SK 海力士等晶片權值股帶動，今年以來報酬率達驚人的 109%。此波走勢凸顯全球 AI 行情正將漲幅集中於區域內少數超大型科技與半導體權值股，市場結構日益向 AI 供應鏈龍頭傾斜。
items.summary_en: Asian equities rode the AI wave on Monday: in Tokyo, a 14% surge in SoftBank Group shares vaulted the OpenAI backer past Toyota Motor to the top of Japan's market-cap rankings. South Korea's Kospi climbed 3.7%, lifted by chip heavyweights Samsung and SK Hynix, pushing its year-to-date return to a remarkable 109%. The moves underscore how the global AI rally is concentrating gains in a handful of mega-cap technology and semiconductor names across the region.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 搶先 OpenAI 遞件申請 IPO AI 上市競賽升溫（2026-06-01）
items.title_en: Anthropic files for IPO ahead of OpenAI as AI listing race heats up (2026-06-01)
items.summary_zh: AI 新創 Anthropic 已遞件申請首次公開發行（IPO），在進軍公開市場的競賽中搶先對手 OpenAI，反映投資人對 AI 投資標的的需求依舊熾熱。此一申請與輝達 Computex 攻勢同步浮現，凸顯生成式 AI 熱潮正帶動一波備受矚目的資本市場活動。Anthropic 若成功掛牌，將為公開市場投資人提供更直接參與前沿大型語言模型開發的管道，並為該產業設下重要的估值標竿。
items.summary_en: AI startup Anthropic has filed for an initial public offering, moving ahead of rival OpenAI in the race to tap public markets, as investor appetite for AI exposure remains intense. The filing, surfacing alongside Nvidia's Computex push, highlights how the generative-AI boom is now feeding a wave of high-profile capital-markets activity. A successful Anthropic listing would offer public investors a more direct play on frontier large-language-model development and set a key valuation benchmark for the sector.
